simple-value.expression: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TAB.STATUS = 'CHEQUE RECEBIDO E DESCONTADO' THEN TAB.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS CHEQUE_R_E_DESCONTADO ,SUM(CASE WHEN TAB.STATUS = 'CHEQUE RECEBIDO E NÃO DESCONTADO' THEN TAB.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS CHEQUE_R_NAO_DESCONTADO ,SUM(CASE WHEN TAB.STATUS = 'CHEQUE NÃO RECEBIDO' THEN TAB.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS CHEQUE_N_RECEBIDO FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA ,FIN.NUFIN ,NVL(CAB.CODPARC, FIN.CODPARC) AS CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,NVL(CAB.CODVEND, FIN.CODVEND) AS CODVEND ,VEN.APELIDO ,NVL(CAB.DTNEG, FIN.DTNEG) AS DTNEG ,NVL(CAB.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUMNOTA) AS NUMNOTA ,FIN.DESDOBRAMENTO ,FIN.VLRBAIXA AS VLRDESDOB ,( SELECT CHQ.NUMCHEQUE FROM TGFCHQ CHQ WHERE CHQ.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN ) AS NR_CHEQUE ,'CHEQUE RECEBIDO E DESCONTADO' AS STATUS FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON FIN.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON VEN.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND OR VEN.CODVEND = FIN.CODVEND WHERE FIN.CODEMP = 501 AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TGFMBC MBC WHERE MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO AND MBC.CONCILIADO = 'S' AND MBC.CODCTABCOINT = 502 ) UNION ALL SELECT CAB.NUNOTA ,FIN.NUFIN ,NVL(CAB.CODPARC, FIN.CODPARC) AS CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,NVL(CAB.CODVEND, FIN.CODVEND) AS CODVEND ,VEN.APELIDO ,NVL(CAB.DTNEG, FIN.DTNEG) AS DTNEG ,NVL(CAB.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUMNOTA) AS NUMNOTA ,FIN.DESDOBRAMENTO ,FIN.VLRBAIXA AS VLRDESDOB ,( SELECT CHQ.NUMCHEQUE FROM TGFCHQ CHQ WHERE CHQ.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN ) AS NR_CHEQUE ,'CHEQUE RECEBIDO E NÃO DESCONTADO' AS STATUS FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON FIN.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON VEN.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND OR VEN.CODVEND = FIN.CODVEND WHERE FIN.CODEMP = 501 AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TGFMBC MBC WHERE MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO AND MBC.CONCILIADO = 'N' AND MBC.CODCTABCOINT = 502 ) UNION ALL SELECT CAB.NUNOTA ,FIN.NUFIN ,CAB.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,CAB.CODVEND ,VEN.APELIDO ,CAB.DTNEG ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,FIN.DESDOBRAMENTO ,FIN.VLRDESDOB ,( SELECT CHQ.NUMCHEQUE FROM TGFCHQ CHQ WHERE CHQ.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN ) AS NR_CHEQUE ,'CHEQUE NÃO RECEBIDO' AS STATUS FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON FIN.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON VEN.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND WHERE CAB.CODEMP = 501 AND CAB.CODTIPVENDA = 139 AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND FIN.CODTIPTIT = 5 AND (FIN.NUBCO IS NULL AND FIN.NUCOMPENS IS NULL) AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' ) TAB
